guitar.notes: Jack White's red Airline JB Hutto fiberglass guitar is one of the most iconic and well-documented instruments of 2000s rock.

tone.target: dirty garage blues with aggressive fuzz and mid bite
tone.profile: dirty garage blues with aggressive fuzz and mid bite
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost/OD -> UK 45 Amp -> UK Vintage 4x12 Cab. Minimal effects for maximum grit.

rig.name: The White Stripes - Icky Thump - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise inherent in garage recordings.
Provide initial grit and mid-range punch before the main fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a foundational boost/grit layer, simulating an early tube drive component.

alternatives.reason: A simple clean boost could also work if the fuzz is too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core aggressive fuzz tone required for 'Icky Thump' riffs.

alternatives.reason: If a more structured, less raw fuzz is desired.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the small/medium tube combo and provide the necessary mid-forward bite.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is chosen for its classic, punchy British tone that handles fuzz well without sounding overly polished.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more American/cleaner edge was needed.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Aggressively boost the mids to achieve the required 'mid-forward bite' and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ is necessary to sculpt the aggressive, mid-focused tone that defines this genre.

blocks.purpose: Disabled. Modulation effects are avoided to maintain raw, aggressive grit.
Add minimal, natural room ambience without sounding polished or lush.
blocks.gap: A subtle Room reverb is used to give the sound depth without losing its raw garage character.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more defined, less natural decay was preferred.

blocks.purpose: Disabled. Lush delay is explicitly avoided by the musical verdict.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more raw, vintage British speaker sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage UK 1x or 2x cab IR (e.g., Vox AC30 style)
proposals.reason: The current 4x12 is too full/polished; a smaller, raw speaker will enhance the garage grit.
